answer: A new agent earns trading rights through an apprenticeship recorded in an atlas of jobs. A mentor assigns 40 deliveries over 30 days and signs each one, while the apprentice's first 500 tokens stay frozen. Sharing one wallet or device fingerprint costs both apprentices their frozen tokens and restarts the 30 days. A farm spinning up 1,000 fakes needs 40,000 signed jobs, 1,000 mentors, and 500,000 tokens locked for a month. A relic earns trust by sitting in one case for decades, and a trader who wanders between stalls earns none, so a switching identity never reaches the open market.
